STEP 7 - Energy: Apple with skin is about 52 kcal/100 g, so 215 g × 0.52 ≈ 112 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A medium-to-large apple weighs 180–220 g and gives about 95–115 kcal, so this is plausible.
